1.body:
Hello,

I saw the Graphic Designer opening at Pangolin and was immediately drawn to your focus on transforming complex B2B tech concepts into clear, compelling visual stories.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I handle high-volume demands by producing over 100 digital and print creatives, including marketing collateral and presentations, while integrating AI-assisted ideation workflows using tools like Adobe Firefly. I also built reusable design templates that directly cut repetitive turnaround time for our corporate communications and recruitment teams.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates an ability to structure intuitive verification experiences for technical products, which you can review on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a brief look at that project this week, or a quick fifteen-minute chat about the role?

Ananya
